Name: Flirtier Bachelors
Author: soshistyle
Description:
[b]Flirty Bachelor Dialogue[/b]
Ever wished Shane, Sam, and Sebastian were a little more flirty? This mod adds a flirtier side to their dialogue, with Alex occasionally joining in, too!
The mod features revamped dialogue for [b]Shane, Sam, and Sebastian[/b], with some flirty moments from [b]Alex[/b] as well. It also includes marriage dialogue for select characters.
Features
[list]
[*]Flirtier dialogue for Shane, Sam, and Sebastian.[/*]
[*]Occasional flirty dialogue for Alex.[/*]
[*]Includes marriage dialogue. (Except for Alex)[/*]
[*][b]i18n compatible[/b], making it easy to add translations into other languages.[/*]
[*]Comes with a [b]Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) translation[/b] already included![/*]
[/list]Credits
All original dialogue credit goes to [b]Kagurahime[/b]. This mod adapts the dialogue for i18n compatibility and includes a Brazilian Portuguese translation.
Portraits used in screenshots available at: https://www.postype.com/@gomim-pixel
